title: Whole Numbers as Fractions
objective: Express whole numbers as fractions and recognize equivalence with different units.

problems.text: Complete the number bond as indicated by the fractional unit. Partition the number line into the given fractional unit, and label the fractions. Rename 0 and 1 as fractions of the given unit.
Circle all the fractions in Problem 1 that are equal to 1. Write them in a number sentence below: 2/2 = ___ = ___ = ___
